## Key Findings Quick Reference

### Universe Distribution
- **Tier 1 (Grade A):** 612 stocks (41%) - Excellent data
- **Tier 2 (Grade B):** 508 stocks (34%) - Good data
- **Tier 3 (Grade C):** 254 stocks (17%) - Acceptable data
- **Tier 4 (Grade D/F):** 119 stocks (8%) - Poor data

**Critical Insight:** 75% of universe has Grade A/B quality

### Top 5 Data Gaps
1. Dividend History (40%) - 597 stocks
2. 5-Year FCF (25%) - 373 stocks
3. Growth Rates (20%) - 299 stocks
4. Stale Data (15%) - 224 stocks
5. Balance Sheet (12%) - 179 stocks

### Recommendations Timeline
- **Week 1:** 5 quick fixes (zero cost)
- **Month 1:** 6 integrations ($50-200/mo)
- **Month 3:** 7 strategic initiatives ($500-1000/mo)
